references.text: Psalm 22 describes the sufferings of a righteous person, which Christians have traditionally interpreted as a prophecy of Jesus' suffering and death.
In Zechariah 12:10 there is a prophecy that they will look on him whom they have pierced, which Christianity interprets as a prophecy of Jesus' crucifixion.
Mark 15:37 also describes Jesus' death in a similar way, emphasizing his cry and the giving up of his spirit.
Luke 23:46 also mentions Jesus' last words on the cross before he died, referring to a similar event.
John 19:30 describes Jesus' death by noting that he said 'It is finished' and gave up his spirit, which is a parallel event.
